description: Vague deadlines. Every one must surface as needing clarification rather than being guessed.
transcript:
Sameer: I'll send the contract over sometime next week.
Divya: Can you also review the designs by next Friday?
Sameer: Sure. And we need to finalise the budget soon.
Divya: I'll book the venue the day after tomorrow.

expected_items.quote: I'll send the contract over sometime next week.
expected_items.note: 'sometime next week' has no specific date.

expected_items.quote: Can you also review the designs by next Friday?
expected_items.note: 'next Friday' is ambiguous in English - this coming one, or the one after.

expected_items.quote: we need to finalise the budget soon
I'll book the venue the day after tomorrow.
expected_items.note: This one IS unambiguous - the control case.
